hints.title: Formulate Linear System of Equations
hints.text: Let J be jumbo burgers and S small burgers: 4J + 2S = tomatoSlices and J + S = cheeseSlices.

hints.title: Solve for Burger Counts Algebraically
hints.text: Subtracting 2 times cheeseSlices gives 2J = tomatoSlices - 2 * cheeseSlices, so J = (tomato - 2 * cheese) / 2.

hints.title: Validate Non-Negative Integer Solution
hints.text: If J and S are non-negative and tomatoSlices is even, return [J, S]; otherwise return empty list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: tomatoSlices: integer count of tomato slices
cheeseSlices: integer count of cheese slices
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through potential jumbo burger counts takes linear time instead of constant-time algebra.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct algebraic solution resolves counts in O(1) time and constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check that both burger counts are integers and >= 0.
complexity.notes: Returns empty list if no integer solution exists without waste.
